name: buddy-codecov
description: Codecov coverage comparison skill for AI coding agents

scripts.coverage: node --input-type=module -e "import { mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'; mkdirSync('coverage', { recursive: true })" && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=src/**/*.mjs --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info tests/*.test.mjs
